name: fspecial
expr: h = fspecial("average", 3); r1 = double(numel(h)); h2 = fspecial('disk',2); d2n = numel(h2); d2c = h2(3,3); d2corner = h2(1,1); d2edge = h2(3,1); d2off = h2(2,2); d2sum = sum(h2(:)); h3 = fspecial('disk',3); d3n = numel(h3); d3c = h3(4,4); h5 = fspecial('disk',5); d5n = numel(h5); d5c = h5(6,6); u = fspecial('unsharp'); un = numel(u); usum = sum(u(:)); uc = u(2,2); ued = u(1,2); ucorn = u(1,1); u5 = fspecial('unsharp',0.5); u5c = u5(2,2); u5ed = u5(1,2); m0 = fspecial('motion',9,0); m0r = size(m0,1); m0c = size(m0,2); m0s = sum(m0(:)); m0v = m0(1,1); m45 = fspecial('motion',9,45); m45r = size(m45,1); m45cc = m45(4,4); m45e = m45(1,7); m5 = fspecial('motion',5,45); m5c = m5(3,3); m90 = fspecial('motion',9,90); m90r = size(m90,1); m90c = size(m90,2);
comment: Sig: h = fspecial(type, params). DEEP-PROBE c160: fspecial('disk',r) now computes MATLAB R2025b's EXACT sub-pixel area-coverage integral, not the prior linear-taper approximation. disk(2)=5x5 sum=1 centre 0.0795774715, corner 0, mid-edge 0.0381149714; disk(3) centre 0.0353677651; disk(5)=11x11 centre 0.0127323954; size 2*ceil(r-0.5)+1. c161: added 'unsharp' (was 'unknown filter type'): 3x3 [-a a-1 -a; a-1 a+5 a-1; -a a-1 -a]/(a+1), default a=0.2 -> centre 4.3333 corner -0.1667 sum=1. c162: added the LAST missing type 'motion' (motion-blur PSF, bilinear-line, ported from fspecial.m): also fixed a fspecial_reg arg bug (a scalar 2nd arg was size-DOUBLED for ALL types, so motion's theta got the len value) by special-casing motion to take raw [len,theta]. Bit-exact vs MATLAB across angles 0/30/45/90/120/135: motion(9,0)=1x9 sum=1 all 1/9; motion(9,45)=7x7 centre 0.0997064915 end 0.0755136399; motion(5,45)=5x5 centre 0.1771490832; motion(9,90)=9x1. 'average'/'gaussian'/'laplacian'/'log'/'sobel'/'prewitt' unchanged. covers:[fspecial].
